landing.what: Run payroll from vaults your company controls, with every payment approved by the people who sign for it.
landing.privacy: Some payments are private and some are public. Anyone can look up a public payment's amount and who received it, and it is marked Public here.

landing.howSigningInWorks: To sign in, your account opens on this page and signs one message saying it is you. Signing in asks for nothing else and shares no key.
signIn.purpose: So Private Vaults knows it is you. Nothing else is asked for.
signIn.refused.title: You are not signed in

signIn.refused.noWindow: Your account did not open, so nothing was signed. Press the button again.

signIn.refused.declined: You did not approve it in your account, so nothing was signed. Press the button again when you are ready.
signIn.refused.expired: The request had expired by the time it reached your account. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.silent: Your account did not answer, so nothing was signed. It may not have finished opening. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.gaveUp: You stopped waiting, so nothing was signed. Press the button again when you are ready.
signIn.refused.didNotFinish: Signing in did not finish, so nothing was signed. Press the button again.
signIn.refused.refused: This site could not confirm the signature from your account, so you are not signed in. Press the button again. If it happens again, check you are using the account you signed up with.
signIn.refused.tooMany: There have been too many tries to sign in. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
signIn.refused.tooManyWait_one: There have been too many tries to sign in. Try again in {count} minute.
signIn.refused.tooManyWait_other: There have been too many tries to sign in. Try again in {count} minutes.
signIn.refused.unavailable: Signing in is not available on this site right now. Try again later.
signIn.refused.unreachable: This site's service could not be reached, so nothing was sent. Check your connection and try again.

setup.step.createCompany.name: Create the company
setup.step.createCompany.line: Name your company. You are its first signer. Until you add signers and choose how many must approve, you approve payments on your own.
setup.step.signers.name: Add signers and set approvals
setup.step.signers.line: Invite the people who approve spending, and choose how many of them must approve each payment.
setup.step.signers.soon: Invite co-signers by link or with a code, and choose how many must approve, for example 2 of 3.
setup.step.handOver.name: Hand the company to its signers
setup.step.handOver.line: Until you do, this service holds a temporary key that can change the rules your company's account follows. Handing it over gives that power to your signers alone.
setup.step.vault.name: Create a vault
setup.step.vault.line: A vault holds the money payroll is paid from.
setup.step.people.name: Add people
setup.step.people.soon: Invite the first people you pay, each by a link of their own.
setup.createCompany.nameHint: This service reads the name once, to set up the company. After that it is kept locked, and only you and the people you add can open it.
setup.createCompany.nameFirst: Enter a name to create the company.
setup.createCompany.how: Your account opens on this page and asks you to approve. That lets this page save your access to the company.
setup.createCompany.created: Your company is created, and your keys for it are saved.
setup.createCompany.waitingTitle: A company you created is not finished
setup.createCompany.waitingBody: Its keys are only in this tab, so they are lost if you close it or sign out. Finish saves them with your other keys.
setup.createCompany.finishFirst: Finish the company you created first.
setup.handOver.what: After this, only your signers can change your company's rules. Those rules decide what every vault pays out. Enough of them must sign each change.
setup.handOver.button: Hand the company to its signers
setup.handOver.permanent: You cannot undo this. When a signer joins or leaves, or approvals change, your signers sign a change to match. Until they do, this app pays nothing in or out of your vaults, and a signer who has left can still act, so make the change straight away.
setup.handOver.everySigner: Every signer must approve every payment and every change. If one of them loses their account for good, nobody can pay out the money in your vaults, ever. Set approvals below the number of signers to avoid this.
setup.handOver.signChange: Sign the change in your account
setup.handOver.goSigners: Go to Add signers and set approvals
setup.handOver.confirmHandOver: You approve in your account. This service then hands the company to the signers your company's own records list. You cannot undo this.
setup.handOver.confirmChange: Your account signs the change that brings the company's account and vaults to your signers as they are now. The change is sent once enough of them have signed.
setup.handOver.why.noCompany: Create the company first. There is nothing to hand over yet.
setup.handOver.why.reading: Checking who holds your company's rules.
setup.handOver.why.notOnChain: Your company is still being set up on the network. Check again shortly.
setup.handOver.why.vaultKeysMissing_one: Your company has {count} signer, you. Give your vault keys before it can be handed over.
setup.handOver.why.vaultKeysMissing_othe: All {count} signers give their vault keys before the company can be handed over. Give yours here. The others give theirs on their own devices.
setup.handOver.why.tooFewApprovals_one: Any one of your {count} signers could change the rules on their own. Set approvals to at least 2 first.
setup.handOver.why.tooFewApprovals_other: Any one of your {count} signers could change the rules on their own. Set approvals to at least 2 first.
setup.handOver.why.held: Done. Your signers now hold the company.
setup.handOver.why.changeOwed: Your signers have changed since the company was handed over. Until the signers who hold it now sign a change to match, this app pays nothing in or out of your vaults, and anyone who has left can still act.
setup.handOver.why.waiting: Either the handover is sent and the network has not confirmed it yet, or this site cannot hand companies over. Check again shortly, and if this stays, contact support.
setup.handOver.why.heldByOtherKeys: Your company's account is held by keys that are not your signers'. Nothing here can change that. Contact support.
setup.handOver.why.unreadable: We could not check who holds your company just now. Nothing was sent. Check again shortly.
setup.handOver.why.unreachable: This site's service could not be reached. Nothing was sent.
act.refused.title: That did not happen
act.refused.notSetUp: This site is not set up to work with your account yet. Tell whoever runs this site.
act.refused.notSignedIn: You are no longer signed in here. Sign in again and try again.
act.refused.anotherPerson: Someone else has signed in on this browser since. Reload the page.
act.refused.signInAgain: This tab was opened after you signed in, so it cannot confirm your account. Nothing was done. Sign out, sign in again, and try again in this tab.
act.refused.keysDidNotOpen: The keys saved for you did not open with the account that answered. Nothing was done. Use the account you set up with.
act.refused.keysWentBack: The keys saved for you changed on another device. Reload the page and try again.
act.refused.declined: You declined in your account. Nothing was done.
act.refused.expired: The request expired before your account answered. Try again.
act.refused.noWindow: Your account could not be shown on this page. Try again.
act.refused.windowGone: Your account was closed before it answered. Try again.
act.refused.gaveUp: You stopped waiting for your account. Nothing was done.
act.refused.silent: Your account did not answer. Try again.
act.refused.noKeysHere: This company is not set up for your account on this device. Open it on the device where you created or joined it.
act.refused.rosterDisagrees: Your company's own records do not match what this service reports, so nothing was sent. Reload the page, and if it happens again, contact support.
act.refused.nothingToSign: There is nothing for you to sign. The other signers sign the rest.
act.refused.unreachable: This site's service could not be reached, so we cannot tell whether this went through. Reload the page to see where things stand before you try again.
act.refused.didNotFinish: It did not finish. Try again, and if it happens again, contact support.
setup.handOver.onlySigner: You are the only signer. If you lose your account for good, nobody can pay out the money in your vaults, ever. Add a second signer to avoid this.
setup.handOver.done.handOver: Sent. Your signers hold the company once the network confirms it. Check again in a minute.
setup.handOver.done.signChange: Your signature is in. The change is sent once enough signers have signed.
